items.title: Jimmy Cobb — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He used to tell me, he said, “Soon as I get the drums, you’re the first guy I want to have to play the drums.”

ctx.x: ’71, I remember it. It just started right around then. It didn’t last very long.
Do you remember a picture of Bradley was in the back, right back of the piano?
